facts.title: Kade: a solar floating studio you can moor in a city canal
facts.description: Kade builds 38 m² timber floating studios with a 9 kWp solar roof and a 30 kWh battery, hand-built in Zaandam in seven months. From €248,000, mooring excluded.
h1: A solar studio you can moor in a city canal.
